references.text: The same chapter mentions earlier that the garment must be burned in fire if it has malignant leprosy, providing context for the burning commandment in verse 55.
Repeats the instruction to burn the garment with fire if the plague appears again, confirming the procedure for unclean objects.
The priest shall examine the plague and isolate it for seven days, illustrating the priest's role in assessing plagues.
The priest shall look at the plague on the seventh day to decide whether it has spread, parallel to the examination after washing.
Concerns leprosy in houses that must be torn down and burned, a similar principle regarding the destruction of unclean material.
Commandment to burn idols with fire, the same principle of destroying unclean things by burning.
